metadata.description: Personal preferences and skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git conventions: Conventional Commits, feature branching from an up-to-date main, and safe history cleanup. Installs GitHub's gh-stack skill for stacked PRs.

plugins.name: gh-stack
plugins.description: GitHub's official agent skill for stacked PRs with the gh stack extension (github/gh-stack), pinned to a reviewed commit.

plugins.name: preferences
plugins.description: Always-on personal working preferences, loaded into every session.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Feature docs and ADRs: templates, writing guidelines, and a Vale check (vale-ai-tells) after every Markdown write.

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Coding conventions (modular code, strict types, Claude owns and improves the codebase). After every code write, a hook formats the file, applies automatic fixes, and reports what's left: ruff and ty for Python, Prettier, ESLint, and tsc for TypeScript, terraform fmt and TFLint for Terraform.
